M1-S04 ships an independent, byte-identical-before-the-fix copy of TestDataFactory.cls that was out of scope for this M1-S03-only repair (S5-F-02, deploy-order.md § 0c); a future dry run over M1-S01..M1-S04 will re-surface the same AccountId FLS failure for any M1-S04 test that seeds Cases the same way unless that copy is repaired too.

This run confirms offline static checks only. No compile check ran (design-only build, no target org, no offline Apex compiler in the sf CLI) so whether the S2-F-12 fix actually clears the org's DmlException on AccountId is unverified until a fresh mock-deploy run.

The milestone's last mock-deploy evidence (run 7) predates this repair and S2-F-11 before it; a fresh dry run with --test-level RunSpecifiedTests or RunLocalTests is the only thing that confirms the 30 test methods now pass.
